translation.title: FIRST IMPRESSION 184：178厘米长腿白皙、拥有真正海外模特身材，曾活跃于世界舞台的北欧混血美女 天音ミシェル 来日AV出道！！
translation.summary: 出生于北欧挪威、身高178厘米、长腿白皙的真正海外模特，震撼来日AV出道！

tags.label: 国际模特
tags.evidence: 标题称她是“本物海外モデル”，并称其“世界で活躍”。

tags.label: 高挑身材
tags.evidence: 标题标明身高178厘米，并提到“脚長”。

vision.label: 格纹连衣裙
vision.evidence: 封面人物穿着蓝灰色格纹连衣裙。

vision.label: 封面文字排版
vision.evidence: 封面上方有大型日文标题，人物姓名和系列编号排在下方。

metadata.evidence: DVD编号为IPZZ690；Peach展示编号采用连字符格式IPZZ-690。
官方详情页的DVD发行日期为2025-08-12。
官方详情页的DVD时长为150分钟。

organize.decision: 将官方关键词搜索结果IPZZ690与其指向的官方详情页关联为同一发行版本的两个参考；二者都不是用户文件。
organize.evidence: 关键词搜索结果IPZZ690指向官方详情页IPZZ-690。

organize.decision: 将DVD IPZZ893与Blu-ray 9IPZZ893归入同一发行版本，同时保留各自的格式信息；不推断两者文件相同。
organize.evidence: 官方详情页将DVD和Blu-ray列为两个格式，时长均为170分钟。

organize.decision: 与IPZZ-893分开归档；同属FIRST IMPRESSION系列不足以证明是同一发行版本。
organize.evidence: IDPC032为系列第197号、橘春花；IPZZ893为第193号、白石るな。

translation.title: FIRST IMPRESSION 184: 178 cm, long-legged and fair-skinned, with a genuine international model’s physique—Nordic beauty 天音ミシェル, who has worked around the world, makes her Japanese AV debut!!
translation.summary: Born in Norway in Northern Europe, this 178 cm, long-legged and fair-skinned international model makes a stunning Japanese AV debut!

tags.label: International model
tags.evidence: The title calls her a “genuine international model” and says she has worked around the world.

tags.label: Tall stature
tags.evidence: The title gives her height as 178 cm and describes her as long-legged.

vision.label: Plaid dress
vision.evidence: The person on the cover wears a blue-gray plaid dress.

vision.label: Cover text layout
vision.evidence: Large Japanese title text appears at the top, with the subject’s name and series number below.

metadata.evidence: The DVD code is IPZZ690; the Peach display code uses a hyphen: IPZZ-690.
The official detail page lists the DVD release date as 2025-08-12.
The official detail page lists the DVD duration as 150 minutes.

organize.decision: Link the official keyword-search result for IPZZ690 to the official detail page it points to as two references to one release; neither is a user file.
organize.evidence: The keyword-search result IPZZ690 points to the official IPZZ-690 detail page.

organize.decision: Group DVD IPZZ893 and Blu-ray 9IPZZ893 under the same release while retaining their distinct format information; do not infer that their files are identical.
organize.evidence: The official detail page lists DVD and Blu-ray as separate formats, both 170 minutes.

organize.decision: Keep separate from IPZZ-893; sharing the FIRST IMPRESSION series does not establish that they are the same release.
organize.evidence: IDPC032 is number 197 with 橘春花; IPZZ893 is number 193 with 白石るな.
